name: Persistent Systems Ltd
about: Persistent Systems provides software engineering and strategy services to help companies implement and modernize their businesses. It has its own software and frameworks with pre-built integration and acceleration [1]. It also has partnership with providers such as Salesforce and AWS [2].

flags.text: Profit grew faster than sales over 3 yrs (27% vs 21% CAGR)
Working capital stretching: cash cycle 62 → 83 days in 2 yrs
Profits are real: 101% of 5-yr profit converted to operating cash

items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
items.quote: the $2 billion by FY27, that's a run rate. We are marching towards it steadily. And again, look, if the macro goes in a different direction going ahead, we'll tackle it as it comes. But otherwise, the run rate wise, we are confident
items.evidence: The company reported quarterly revenue of 4664 Cr in Sep 2026, which exceeds the 2 billion USD run rate target.

items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
items.quote: FY’27, Q4 exit is where we are looking at the run rate being in the range of $500 million or so.
items.evidence: The company reported quarterly revenue of 4664 Cr in Sep 2026, which exceeds the 500 million USD run rate target for Q4 FY27.

items.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
items.quote: Our aspiration continues to be in the 16 to 17% range.
items.evidence: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 14% in Sep 2026, which is below the 16-17% aspiration.

items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
items.quote: This is a net new deal which will add roughly about $125 million plus on an annual basis and overall for the period of the contract it will be roughly about $650 million plus over 6.5 years.
items.evidence: The 6.5-year contract duration for the order inflow target has not yet elapsed.

items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
items.quote: We add to the European business, we live to our dream of having European business at 15% plus. In fact, it's a very nice combination which gets us to 22% in Europe
items.evidence: The provided tables do not contain geographic revenue breakdowns.

items.speaker: Vinit Teredesai
items.quote: The transaction is expected to be Cash EPS accretive as well as Reported EPS accretive in Year 1 if you remove the transaction expenses that will be incurred in the first year.
items.evidence: The one-year period for assessing EPS accretion following the Aug 2026 call has not yet elapsed.

items.speaker: Sandeep Kalra
items.quote: Many of you have asked us in Earning Calls before, do we need additional verticals to scale to the aspiration of $5 billion that we have? By FY31, we get that as well at a nice scale.
items.evidence: The FY31 target date for the 5 billion USD revenue goal has not yet been reached.

promises.summary: Management has successfully delivered on short-term revenue growth targets but is currently missing its stated EBIT margin aspirations.

bull.point: Revenue growth is accelerating, reaching 30.2% YoY in Sep 2026, demonstrating strong market demand.
The company successfully exceeded its $2 billion revenue run rate target by Sep 2026.
Profitability remains robust with a 101% conversion rate of five-year profits into operating cash.

bear.point: EBITDA margins have deteriorated significantly, falling to 14% in Sep 2026 from 19% in Mar 2026.
Net profit declined sharply to 352 Cr in Sep 2026 from 483 Cr in Jun 2026.
Working capital efficiency is declining, with the cash cycle stretching from 62 to 83 days.
